newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Foreigners are net buyers in Taiwan stocks in Oct.
newsitem.headline: Foreigners are net buyers in Taiwan stocks in Oct.

text.p: Foreign investors were net buyers of T$3.171 billion in Taiwan stocks so far in October, the Taiwan Stock Exchange said on Wednesday.
As of October 23, foreigners had bought a total of T$23.807 billion in Taiwan stocks and sold a total of T$20.636 billion, the exchange said in a statement.
But on Wednesday alone, foreign investors were net sellers of T$619 million, buying T$1.098 billion and selling T$1.717 bilion.
The island's bourse has stayed in a consolidation in recent sessions, with selling by foreign institutions balanced by renewed local investment interest.
The weighted index finished up 10.76 points -- a scant 0.17 percent -- to 6,437.06 on Wednesday.
